ValidationRule.description: Check to make sure that "Primary Quote" is blank before "Fee Inclusive" box can be checked
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula:
OR( AND( ISCHANGED( Fee_Inclusive__c ), Fee_Inclusive__c = true, NOT(ISPICKVAL( NSP_PrimaryProduct__c, "WO")), NOT(ISPICKVAL( NSP_PrimaryProduct__c, "WS")), NOT(ISPICKVAL( NSP_PrimaryProduct__c, "Performance Management")), NOT(ISPICKVAL( NSP_PrimaryProduct__c, "Time & Attendance"))),
AND( Fee_Inclusive__c = true, ISCHANGED( NSP_PrimaryProduct__c ), NOT(ISPICKVAL( NSP_PrimaryProduct__c, "WO")), NOT(ISPICKVAL( NSP_PrimaryProduct__c, "WS")), NOT(ISPICKVAL( NSP_PrimaryProduct__c, "Performance Management")), NOT(ISPICKVAL( NSP_PrimaryProduct__c, "Time & Attendance"))),
AND( NOT(ISBLANK( SBQQ__PrimaryQuote__c)), ISCHANGED( Fee_Inclusive__c ), Fee_Inclusive__c = true ),
AND(Fee_Inclusive__c = true, NOT(ISBLANK( SBQQ__PrimaryQuote__c)), ISCHANGED(StageName), ISPICKVAL( StageName, "Closed Won")) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: A Fee Inclusive Opportunity can not have an assigned Primary Quote, and must have a Primary Product of: WO, WS, Performance Management, or Time & Attendance
